entities.name: Yahenni
entities.description: An aetherborn socialite and philanthropist, minutes from death, who discovers they can drain essence from living people to extend their life.

entities.name: Nived
entities.description: Yahenni's favorite caterer, who paints the renegade symbol on the Museum of Invention and is shocked unconscious by a Consulate enforcer.

entities.name: Consulate enforcer
entities.description: A sadistic Consulate enforcer who torments Nived and hunts for sympathizers of the renegades; killed by Yahenni.

entities.name: Gonti
entities.description: An infamous aetherborn crime lord with a manufactured metal heart, who sends Yahenni to warn the renegades so they will move against the Consulate.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A human pyromancer and planeswalker, daughter of Pia Nalaar, hiding with the renegades and Gatewatch.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: An elf planeswalker and Gatewatch member who comforts Yahenni with a current of land energy.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A planeswalker of the Gatewatch hiding in the statue, who uses mind magic to hurt Yahenni on the ladder.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: A planeswalker of the Gatewatch in a dark dress with fur at the collar.

entities.name: Gideon Jura
entities.description: A beefy, sideburned human planeswalker of the Gatewatch who watches the outside through a gap in the walls.

entities.name: Ajani Goldmane
entities.description: A leonin planeswalker waiting with Mrs. Pashiri at the ration line.

entities.name: Pia Nalaar
entities.description: Chandra's mother, a criminal in the Consulate's eyes, now free and meeting other renegades.

entities.name: Oviya Pashiri
entities.description: A friend of the renegades who is with Ajani at the receiving line for grocery rations.

entities.name: Tezzeret
entities.description: A planeswalker the Gatewatch fears may accompany the Consulate; Chandra calls him a tool.

entities.name: Depala
entities.description: A dwarven friend of Yahenni whose pet hyena Yahenni accidentally killed at four weeks old.

entities.name: Rajul
entities.description: A great aetherborn inventor who pioneered medical technology for non-organic beings and has a statue in the Statuary Garden.

entities.name: The Aradaras
entities.description: The mother-and-son team who perfected the aether-propelled train and started the tradition of inventor statues.

entities.name: The Consulate
entities.description: The governing body of Ghirapur which confiscated unapproved devices, cut energy access and imposed a curfew.

entities.name: The Renegades
entities.description: A rebel faction opposing the Consulate, whose symbol is the leaking spire.

entities.name: The Gatewatch
entities.description: The group of planeswalkers hiding with the renegades.

entities.name: Ghirapur
entities.description: The city of Kaladesh under Consulate curfew.

entities.name: Kaladesh
entities.description: The plane on which the story takes place.

entities.name: The Weldfast
entities.description: A district of Ghirapur and once the best night district of the city, now shut down under curfew.

entities.name: The Museum of Invention
entities.description: A Ghirapur museum covered in Consulate banners, where Nived paints the leaking spire.

entities.name: The Statuary Garden
entities.description: A massive arboretum near Aradara Station lined with statues of Ghirapur's most famous inventors; the renegades hide in a statue there.

entities.name: Aradara Station
entities.description: A station near the Statuary Garden.

entities.name: Yahenni's penthouse
entities.description: Yahenni's secure penthouse with more than seven bedrooms, offered as a hideout.

entities.name: Gonti's residence
entities.description: A palace disguised as a warehouse, full of stolen opulence and devices hidden from the Consulate.

entities.name: The Great Conduit
entities.description: A mural of it decorates Gonti's room; Yahenni wonders whether aetherborn float in it before life.

entities.name: Aether
entities.description: The substance aetherborn are made of, restricted by the Consulate's ordinances.

entities.name: Penultimate Party
entities.description: The party every aetherborn is supposed to be guaranteed before they die.

entities.name: The leaking spire
entities.description: The renegade symbol: an upside down Consulate symbol with flourishes emptying out of the bottom, representing hope that aether is returned to the people.

entities.name: Aetherborn
entities.description: Short-lived empathic beings born of aether, like Yahenni and Gonti.

entities.name: Gremlin
entities.description: A starving gremlin follows Yahenni, waiting for them to die.

events.summary: Yahenni, minutes from death, stumbles through the curfew-empty Weldfast looking for someone to be with them.
events.quote: It is dark and I am the only person shambling under the eaves of the Weldfast.

events.summary: Yahenni realizes they will die alone and panics, then smells a familiar friend.
events.quote: I'm going to die alone.

events.summary: Yahenni finds Nived painting the renegade leaking spire over torn Consulate banners at the Museum of Invention.
events.quote: From across the street I can make out a human figure putting the final touches on their graffiti.

events.summary: Yahenni apologizes to Nived for canceling his catering of their Penultimate Party at the last moment.
events.quote: "I'm sorry...I canceled...less than a day prior to when my party was scheduled..."

events.summary: A Consulate enforcer and an armament automaton arrest Nived for vandalism and shock him unconscious with an energy device.
events.quote: Nived screams, seizes, and topples to the ground.

events.summary: The enforcer repeatedly shocks and kicks the unconscious Nived while demanding what Yahenni knows about six renegade sympathizers, including Pia Nalaar's daughter.
events.quote: I'm looking for six individuals that are sympathetic to the renegades' cause.

events.summary: Yahenni drains the enforcer's essence, killing them, feeling their death, and restoring their own body for twelve days.
events.quote: I claw my right hand and pull from the enforcer's neck.

events.summary: Yahenni realizes they have killed a person and are a murderer, but rationalizes that they may live by killing bad people.
events.quote: ...I am a murderer.

events.summary: Yahenni hides Nived behind a stall and decides to find the renegades and the criminal's daughter, then seek Gonti's help.
events.quote: I need to find the renegades.

events.summary: Yahenni gets Nived home and reaches Gonti's palace-like hideout, where Gonti is bathing in aether attar, a metal lump visible on their chest.
events.quote: Gonti sits submerged, their face covered with a gilded mask.

events.summary: Yahenni blackmails Gonti with the secret of their manufactured heart, asking where Chandra and Pia Nalaar are hiding.
events.quote: "If you tell me where they are hiding, I will keep the secret of your manufactured heart to myself.

events.summary: Gonti realizes Yahenni is an essence drainer and reveals having employed two before.
events.quote: "Essence drainers are rare," Gonti replies, "I've only ever had two in my employment.

events.summary: Gonti reveals the renegades' safe house in the Statuary Garden and tasks Yahenni with warning them that the Consulate is coming, to force them into acting.
events.quote: You'll find the younger Nalaar and her associates in a safe house within the Statuary Garden.

events.summary: Yahenni goes to the Statuary Garden and climbs a ladder up a Vedalken inventor's statue where they sense the hidden renegades.
events.quote: I walk casually toward the statue and start to climb a ladder around the back.

events.summary: Jace causes Yahenni a body ache on the ladder until Nissa and Chandra recognize them and let them into the hideout.
events.quote: "Yahenni!" Chandra yells while opening the hatch and pulling me through.

events.summary: Chandra introduces Yahenni to Jace, Liliana and Gideon; Chandra says they got her mother free.
events.quote: Yahenni, this man is Jace, this woman is Liliana, and the man in the corner is Gideon.

events.summary: Yahenni warns that the Consulate is on its way and offers their penthouse as a safe hideout; the group agrees.
events.quote: My penthouse is safe.

events.summary: Yahenni, descending the ladder, sees a Consulate cruiser speeding toward the statue and leaps onto its hood, draining the enforcer driver to death.
events.quote: And I jump down.

events.summary: The enforcer's cruiser crashes into another statue; Yahenni's life is extended to twenty-two days.
events.quote: I now have twenty-two days left to live.

events.summary: Nissa has Gideon call back Chandra, who walked the wrong way, and directs the group to Yahenni's home and sends word to Ajani, Pia and Mrs. Pashiri.
events.quote: Tell Chandra Yahenni's home is that way, and have Jace inform Ajani, Pia, and Mrs. Pashiri of our new location

events.summary: Nissa comforts Yahenni with a current of land energy, telling them they are her friend; Yahenni resolves to do good with their remaining days.
events.quote: "Because you are my friend," she says delicately.

relations.note: Yahenni drains the enforcer to death.
Yahenni resolves to kill bad people and help the renegades.
relations.quote: I want to join the renegade cause

relations.note: Nissa says they are her friend.
relations.quote: "Because you are my friend," she says delicately.

relations.note: Nived is Yahenni's favorite caterer and friend.

relations.quote: "Happy to have you there. I heard you found your parent."

relations.note: Gonti is the crime lord whose residence hides stolen devices.
relations.quote: the private residence of the infamous crime lord Gonti

relations.note: Gonti calls the curfew and confiscation a curse on the city.
relations.quote: the Consulate's mandatory curfew and confiscation of our personal property is a curse on our city
"This is Yahenni. They're someone we can trust," Chandra says as an introduction to the group.

relations.note: She grimly warns Tezzeret might come with the Consulate.
relations.quote: "Tezzeret might be with them," the woman in the dark dress states grimly.

relations.note: Chandra spits that he is a tool.

relations.quote: What used to be the best night district in the city is boarded up

relations.note: A garden in the city near Aradara Station.
relations.quote: The Statuary Garden is a massive arboretum near Aradara Station.
